query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('67ab0c92c4ac1610895a1c965ee50aba41a8f1513b15240723b3bd0b', 'a15ce9d82d2f67645fc624e2edac03c6f1c106d0ad1af5815a3b14ad', 'ad6424e3ce9e47bbd8364984bd731b41de591f1d11f6d7d43d0da9b9', 'bd2adb685621e224aae7571cb6bd8f0beb0fdd31875eb3a27feee6c0')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
